_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for TCT_NGC dev30 negative/background classes excluded from detection (base) mAP. These are non-diagnostic / benign categories that are NOT detection targets. EDIT ONLY HERE -- the two ochmta_m1 configs read this file directly (json.load), and the eval scripts read it via wedetect.utils.load_dev30_negative_classes. tools/clinical_cost_config_dev30.json tiers.L0_negative must mirror this list (verified by tools/check_negative_class_consistency.py).

rationale.Serous effusion-Negative samples: TIS II NFM -- negative for malignancy
rationale.Thyroid gland-NS: Bethesda I Nondiagnostic -- scant follicular cells; added 2026-06-09 (previously omitted, so it was wrongly counted in the Thyroid organ base mAP)
rationale.Thyroid gland-Negative samples: Bethesda II Benign -- follicular nodular disease
rationale.Urine-NHGUC: Paris II NHGUC -- negative for high-grade urothelial carcinoma
rationale.TCT_CCD-normal: Bethesda NILM -- negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy
